## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: SPY/TLT rising (Stocks vs Bonds 1W: +1.13% | 1M: +9.47% ↑ rising; SPY (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.70%) ABOVE TREND) and VXX rising (VXX (1W: +2.80% | 1M: -13.02%) RECOVERY ↑ rising), while credit stress is rising (HYG (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +1.83%) CORRECTION; LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +1.21%) CORRECTION) — mixed signals.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress RISING: HYG/LQD showing tightening signals (HYG (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +1.83%) CORRECTION; LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +1.21%) CORRECTION). Fear tick higher: VXX (1W: +2.80% | 1M: -13.02%) RECOVERY ↑ rising. Stocks retain leadership vs bonds: SPY (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.70%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: -0.41% | 1M: +0.25%) CORRECTION.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-cautious: UUP proxy (Dollar Strength 1W: +0.59% | 1M: -1.19% → flat RECOVERY) and yield curve relatively flat (Yield Curve 1W: -0.35% | 1M: +0.37% → flat CORRECTION); TLT (1W: -0.41% | 1M: +0.25%) CORRECTION shows duration mixed.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech leadership intact: XLK (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +17.15%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +11.04% | 1M: +33.70%) ABOVE TREND. Energy showing strength but mixed durability: XLE (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -6.11%) RECOVERY. Style mixed — tech out vs several cyclicals and defensives slipping.

**5. US vs Global?**
US outperforming broadly: SPY (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.70%) ABOVE TREND; EM via EEM (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +11.01%) ABOVE TREND but China lagging: FXI (1W: -1.97% | 1M: +2.39%) CORRECTION and China Tech under pressure (China Tech vs US Tech 1W: -7.27% | 1M: -11.64% ↓ falling).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation cooling: Speculation Index (1W: -4.26% | 1M: +2.57%) CORRECTION. ARKK (1W: -3.45% | 1M: +9.44%) CORRECTION while IWM (1W: +0.32% | 1M: +9.86%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +0.18% | 1M: +9.58%) ABOVE TREND show selective risk-taking.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Metals/industrial themes recovering but choppy: CPER (1W: -0.94% | 1M: +9.32%) CORRECTION; gold taking profit: GLD (1W: -2.84% | 1M: +4.07%) CORRECTION ↓ falling.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Oil surge headline: USO (1W: +14.10% | 1M: +16.77%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +15.66% | 1M: +7.83%) ABOVE TREND; XLE (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -6.11%) RECOVERY. Natural gas weak: UNG (1W: -4.89% | 1M: -13.07%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Tech/semis leadership — XLK and SOXX both ABOVE TREND (XLK (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +17.15%), SOXX (1W: +11.04% | 1M: +33.70%)). DIVERGENCE: TLT showing short-term weakness vs 1M (TLT (1W: -0.41% | 1M: +0.25%) CORRECTION) and multiple 1W/1M corrections across XLY, XBI, ARKK — watch for momentum fade.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to tech/semis and select energy commodity exposure given momentum; reduce exposure to areas showing 1W weakness (healthcare/consumer discretionary) and monitor credit stress (HYG/LQD).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +17.15%) ABOVE TREND; SOXX (1W: +11.04% | 1M: +33.70%) ABOVE TREND; USO (1W: +14.10% | 1M: +16.77%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: XLV (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -1.41%) BELOW TREND; XBI (1W: -3.89% | 1M: +7.55%) CORRECTION; FXI (1W: -1.97% | 1M: +2.39%) CORRECTION.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Oil ETFs USO (1W: +14.10% | 1M: +16.77%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +15.66% | 1M: +7.83%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: UNG (1W: -4.89% | 1M: -13.07%) BELOW TREND; GLD (1W: -2.84% | 1M: +4.07%) CORRECTION watch for further pullback.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~29.79 (VXX (1W: +2.80% | 1M: -13.02%) RECOVERY) — watch for further mood swings; Credit Spread ~0.7343 (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +0.45%) ABOVE TREND — monitor widening; SPY/TLT 8.2337 (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +9.47%) ↑ rising and Tech vs Financials 3.1159 (1W: +6.10% | 1M: +15.35%) ABOVE TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive.  
Tech and semiconductors showing strength — XLK (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +17.15%) ABOVE TREND; SOXX (1W: +11.04% | 1M: +33.70%) ABOVE TREND.  
Key risk: rising credit stress (HYG (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +1.83%) CORRECTION; LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +1.21%) CORRECTION) and short-term volatility uptick (VXX (1W: +2.80% | 1M: -13.02%) RECOVERY) to monitor.
